items.title: Neeman’s Appoints Akshit Dhingra As Vice President Of Brand Marketing - IFAB MEDIA
items.raw_summary: Neeman’s Has Appointed Akshit Dhingra As Vice President Of Brand Marketing. In His New Role, Dhingra Will Lead Brand Strategy, Consumer Marketing And Integrated Brand-building Initiatives For The Footwear Brand. He Joins Neeman’s From Campus Activewear, Where He Served As AVP Marketing And Worked On Integrated Marketing Initiatives. Dhingra Brings Nearly Two Decades Of Experience Across Brand Strategy, Consumer Marketing, Insights And Growth. Before Campus Activewear, He Held Leadership Roles At Lactalis India And Cream Bell Ice Cream. He Began His Career In Consumer And Market Research. Commenting On Akshit’s Appointment, Taranjeet Singh Chhabra, Co-founder & CEO, Neeman’s, Said: “As Neeman’s Enters Its Next Phase Of Growth, Building A Stronger And More Enduring Brand Remains A Key Priority. Akshit Brings Deep Expertise Across Brand Building, Consumer Insights, Media, And Business Growth. His Appointment Reflects Our Commitment To Investing In Leadership Talent That Can Help Shape The Next Chapter Of Neeman’s.” Speaking About Joining Neeman’s, Akshit Dhingra Said: “The Best Brands Don’t Just Sell Products; They Reflect Shifts In Culture. That’s What Drew Me To Neeman’s. What Personally Resonates With Me Is That The Brand Has Built Remarkable Customer Loyalty By Standing For Comfort, Sustainability, And Everyday Living At A Time When The World Often Celebrates Speed And Hustle. As The Brand Now Invests In Broader Growth, It Feels Like The Beginning Of An Exciting New Chapter.”

items.title: [McCann] Consumers place greater value on brand truth - marketingreport.one
items.raw_summary: A new global study from McCann has found that trust and transparency are becoming increasingly important drivers of brand growth, with 72 per cent of consumers saying it is more important than ever to prioritise truth.
